info.description: HTTP API of the multi-tenant application platform. Every successful body is {"data": ...} (collections add "pagination"); every failure is {"error": {code, message, fields?, requestId, traceId?}}.
info.title: Platform API

get.description: Answers 204 and sets the XSRF-TOKEN cookie. A browser page reads that cookie and sends its value in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header with every state-changing request, which the server compares with the cookie.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.description: For a person who already has an account and is signed in as the invited address. Creates the membership and answers the organization. Anybody else, and any unusable link, gets the same VALIDATION_ERROR on the field token, and the link stays usable for the right person.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Accept an invitation as a signed-in person

post.description: Public: the token from the mailed link is the proof. Creates the account and the membership. Answers the organization to sign in at. An unusable link, or an address that has an account by now, is a VALIDATION_ERROR on the field token; a password that breaks the policy is one on password and leaves the link usable.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Accept an invitation by choosing a name and a password

post.description: Public: the token from the mailed link is the proof. Answers the organization's name, the invited address and whether that address already has an account (which decides whether the person chooses a password or signs in). A link that is unknown, used, replaced, revoked or expired is a VALIDATION_ERROR on the field token, always with the same message.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Read what an invitation link is for

get.description: The signed-in user. 401 UNAUTHENTICATED without a valid token. Says nothing about what the user may do in an organization: permissions are decided elsewhere, per organization. On the platform host it also lists the platform roles, for presentation only.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.description: Needs the current password and a new one that meets the password policy. Ends every session of the user, including this one: sign in again afterwards.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Change the password of the signed-in user

post.description: Always answers 202 with the same text, whether or not the address has an account: if it has an active one, an e-mail with a link follows. Only on the platform host. A locked account can be reset. Too many requests answer 429 RATE_LIMITED.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Ask for a password-reset link

post.description: Answers 204 and ends every session of the user, on every device; the person signs in again. A link that is unknown, used, replaced or expired is a VALIDATION_ERROR on the field token. A password that breaks the policy is a VALIDATION_ERROR on the field newPassword and leaves the link usable.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Set a new password with the token from the e-mailed link

post.description: Uses the refresh cookie. Answers 204 with new cookies, or 401 UNAUTHENTICATED with the cookies removed when the refresh token is unknown, expired, revoked or was already used.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Replace the session tokens

post.description: On success answers 204 and sets the short-lived login cookie; the browser then continues with the sign-in page navigation (/api/v1/auth/start) to receive its session cookies. Every kind of failure (unknown address, wrong password, locked, disabled, not yet verified) answers the same 401 UNAUTHENTICATED; too many attempts answer 429 RATE_LIMITED.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Check an email address and a password

post.description: Revokes the tokens the browser presents and removes the cookies. Always answers 204: signing out when not signed in is not an error.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: End the current sign-in

post.description: Revokes every session and token of the signed-in user, on every device and instance, at once.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: End every sign-in of the user

post.description: Always answers 202 with the same text, whether or not the address already has an account: if it may sign up, an e-mail with a link follows. Only on the platform host. Asking again is the way to have the e-mail sent again; a newer link replaces the older one. Too many requests answer 429 RATE_LIMITED.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Start a sign-up with an e-mail address

post.description: Answers 204 when the account was created; the person then signs in. A link that is unknown, used, replaced or expired is a VALIDATION_ERROR on the field token, always with the same message. A password that breaks the policy is a VALIDATION_ERROR on the field password and leaves the link usable.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Create the account with the token from the e-mailed link

post.description: Answers the destination host and a one-time proof, valid for a minute. The browser opens the destination's switch page with the proof after the #. An organization that does not exist and one the caller does not belong to give the same NOT_FOUND.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Ask to continue in another of your organizations

post.description: Public, on an organization host: the proof from the previous host is the credential. On success answers 204 and sets the short-lived login cookie; the browser then continues with the sign-in navigation (/api/v1/auth/start). A proof that is unknown, used, expired, made for another organization, or whose person is not a member here is a VALIDATION_ERROR on the field token, always with the same message.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Continue in this organization with the one-time proof

get.description: Newest first, with their state: OPEN, EXPIRED, ACCEPTED or REVOKED. For administrators.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

get.summary: List the invitations of the organization

post.description: Always answers 202 with the same text, whether or not the address has an account or is already a member: if it can be invited, an e-mail with a link follows. Inviting an address that has an open invitation sends it again. The invitation grants nothing until accepted. For administrators of the organization of the host. Too many requests answer 429 RATE_LIMITED.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Invite an address into the organization

post.description: A new link replaces the old one and the time starts again. Answers 202 like the invitation. CONFLICT when the invitation is no longer open; NOT_FOUND for an invitation of another organization.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Send an open invitation again

post.description: Its link stops working at once. CONFLICT when the invitation is no longer open; NOT_FOUND for an invitation of another organization.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Withdraw an open invitation

get.description: Per licence type: how many licences the organization holds, how many are assigned and how many are free. For the administrators of the organization of the host. NOT_FOUND on the platform host.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

get.summary: The licence pools of the organization

get.description: For the administrators of the organization of the host. NOT_FOUND on the platform host, FORBIDDEN for a member who is not an administrator.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

get.summary: List the members of the organization

put.description: A stop-gap until access policies exist. The last administrator cannot be released (CONFLICT). Only an active member can be an administrator.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

put.summary: Name a member an administrator, or release them

post.description: The member is signed out of this organization at once and cannot get back in until reactivated; their other organizations are untouched. CONFLICT when already deactivated or when this is the last administrator. NOT_FOUND for a member of another organization.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Deactivate a member

delete.description: The licence returns to the pool. Nothing happens when the member holds none.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

put.description: Moves the member from the licence type they hold, if any. CONFLICT when none is free of that type or the member is not active; two administrators asking for the last free licence have one winner. A licence counts assignments only: it grants no permission.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.description: The person can sign in again; sessions that ended do not come back and the administrator marker is not restored. CONFLICT when the member is not deactivated.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Reactivate a deactivated member

post.description: Ends every session and token bound to this organization host except the caller own. For the administrators of the organization of the host; audited.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Sign everybody else out of the organization

get.description: For the organization switcher, on any host: the answer is the caller's own memberships, not the organization the host names. Each entry carries the host the server built for it.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

get.summary: The organizations the signed-in person is an active member of

post.description: The signed-in person creates an organization and becomes its founding administrator. The short name (slug) becomes the first label of the organization's host name. Answers 201 with the host to sign in at. A name or slug that is not acceptable or not free is a VALIDATION_ERROR on its field; a person who already founded as many organizations as allowed is FORBIDDEN. Only on the platform host.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Found an organization

get.description: For platform administrators, billing and support.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.description: CONFLICT when the key exists. For platform administrators and billing.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Add a feature key

get.description: For platform administrators, billing and support.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.description: CONFLICT when the key exists. For platform administrators and billing.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Add a licence type

get.description: By short name, one page at a time. For platform administrators, support and billing. Never shows members or business data. Platform host only.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.description: Creates the organization on a plan and invites its first administrator. The organization stays closed (its host answers not available) until that person accepts, which opens it. The answer is the same whether or not the address has an account. For platform administrators.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Set up an organization for a client

get.description: Status, subscription, licence pools, features and the state of the first-administrator invitation (never its address). For platform administrators, support and billing.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.description: Final. Needs a reason and the short name of the organization typed again as confirmation. Open invitations are withdrawn and sessions end. Also cancels an organization that was still being set up. For platform administrators.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Close an organization for good

put.description: Over the plan default; an absent value removes the override. For platform administrators.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

put.summary: Switch a feature on or off for an organization

post.description: For an organization that is being set up, or that lost every administrator. Always answers 202 with the same text whether or not the address has an account. For platform administrators.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Invite a new first administrator

post.description: A new link replaces the old one and the time starts again. CONFLICT when it is no longer open. For platform administrators and support.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Send the first-administrator invitation again

put.description: Not below the licences in use (CONFLICT). For platform administrators.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

put.summary: Set the size of a licence pool of an organization

post.description: People sign in again; sessions that ended do not come back. Needs a reason. For platform administrators.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Reinstate a suspended organization

post.description: Ends every session and token bound to the organization host. Needs a reason. For platform administrators and support.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Sign everybody out of an organization

put.description: Plan, status and dates; also puts an organization without a plan on one. A plan that would leave a licence pool below the licences in use is refused (CONFLICT). No payment is involved. For platform administrators and billing.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

put.summary: Change the subscription of an organization

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

get.summary: The support-access requests of an organization

post.description: A reason and 15 to 240 minutes. Nothing is granted until an administrator of the organization approves it. One open request per person and organization (CONFLICT). For platform administrators and support.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Ask an organization for support access

post.description: Only the person who asked can. CONFLICT when it is no longer open.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Withdraw your own open request

post.description: Its host answers not available at once and everybody signed in loses access. Needs a reason (kept in the audit trail only). For platform administrators.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Suspend an organization

get.description: For platform administrators. Platform host only.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.description: The person must already have an active account. VALIDATION_ERROR when no active account has the address, CONFLICT when the person holds the role. Audited. For platform administrators.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Give a platform role to a person

delete.description: CONFLICT for the last platform administrator. Audited. For platform administrators.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

get.description: Default licence quantities and included features. For platform administrators, billing and support.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

put.description: Organizations keep their pools until their subscription changes plan. For platform administrators and billing.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

put.summary: Create a plan, or replace the one with this key

post.description: When each began and ends and which host it works on; never a token or a secret. An unknown address gives an empty list. For platform administrators and support.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: The live sign-ins of a person

post.description: Ends every session and token of the person on every host. Answers 204 whether or not the address has an account. For platform administrators and support.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Sign a person out everywhere

get.description: Succeeds when the API is running and its database answered a query.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

get.description: Who asked, why, and what became of it. For the administrators of the organization of the host. NOT_FOUND on the platform host.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.description: Opens a window of at most the minutes asked for and four hours; it ends by itself. CONFLICT when the request is no longer open.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Approve a support-access request

post.description: CONFLICT when the request is no longer open.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: Deny a support-access request

post.description: CONFLICT when the access is not approved.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

post.summary: End an approved support access now

get.description: Answers with the organization the request's host name addresses. A host that addresses no organization, or an unknown one, is NOT_FOUND; a suspended, deactivated or not yet open one is TENANT_UNAVAILABLE. The organization can never be chosen by a header, parameter or body.

default.description: Error. The code says what went wrong; the message is safe to show.

get.summary: The organization of this host name

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Branch on this, never on the message.
